meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 用户报 bug 后,Claude 会先对照源码复现并确认根因,再把问题整理成规范的 GitHub issue:写明标题、环境、复现步骤、修复建议和验证计划,打上 lazycodex-generated 标签提交到对应仓库;若已有相同 issue,则在评论里补充证据。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等项目的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我向 LazyCodex 仓库报个 bug:安装时总在最后一步失败。
say.note: 它会先复现,再生成带根因的 issue。

say.text: 这个报错在纯上游 Codex 里也能复现,帮我开个 issue。
say.note: 它会路由到 openai/codex 并给出证据。

say.text: 查一下 LazyCodex 已有相似 issue,把新证据补上去。
say.note: 它不会重复建单,会在原 issue 追加评论。

howto.what_en: Claude reproduces reported bugs against the latest LazyCodex and Codex sources, confirms root cause, and files a labeled GitHub issue/PR in the owning repo. A matching open issue gets an evidence comment instead of a duplicate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugins, or upstream Codex CLI, etc.

say_en.text: Report a LazyCodex bug: the installer always fails at the last step.
say_en.note: It will reproduce first, then file an issue with root cause.

say_en.text: This crash reproduces in clean upstream Codex; open an issue there.
say_en.note: It will route to openai/codex with evidence.

say_en.text: There is already a LazyCodex issue like this; add the new evidence.
say_en.note: It comments on the existing issue instead of duplicating it.
